2027-01-19.title: The Greatest Miracle
2027-01-19.verse: In the beginning God created the heavens and the earth.
2027-01-19.observation: When you think about it, the first verse is easily the greatest in the entire Bible. If God can create the heavens and the earth, then anything else is possible. When we also realize that the book of Genesis was written to the recently liberated people of Israel, we realize that God was correcting any false theology they had picked up in the nation of Egypt. Creation was not a group effort. Creation was by the one and only sovereign God. That reminds us that our King reigns supreme, He is above all, and nothing is impossible with Him.
2027-01-19.application: Think about the greatness of God. Everything you see has been created by God.
2027-01-19.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for calling us Your special creation out of all the wonders You have made.

2027-01-20.title: God’s Hope of Innocence
2027-01-20.verse: The man and his wife were both naked, but they were not ashamed.
2027-01-20.observation: In the beginning, God’s plan for His people was to live in innocence. We were not supposed to have to be concerned with sin, shame, or anything that would bring guilt upon our lives. It was sin that caused us to think negatively about ourselves and others. When we receive salvation, we begin the journey back to the state of innocence God intended for us.
2027-01-20.application: Is there a place in your life where you think of yourself only in terms of shame? Where do you need God to bring freedom?
2027-01-20.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for healing us from the inside out.

2027-01-21.title: God’s Plan for Us
2027-01-21.verse: Then the man and his wife heard the sound of the Lord God moving about in the orchard at the breezy time of the day, and they hid from the Lord God among the trees of the orchard.
2027-01-21.observation: I heard someone once say that all of the Bible from Genesis 4 through Revelation 22 is an effort to bring people back to Genesis 3:8. There was a time when people spent their days caring for the things God had made and spent time with God Himself every evening. There was an innocent, beautiful closeness that was enjoyed. When sin came in, all that was destroyed. The rest of the Bible is God’s effort to redeem His creation and bring us back to this place of joy.
2027-01-21.application: Have you thought about how we can “fellowship” with God now because of what Christ has done? What if you took a walk with the Lord today?
2027-01-21.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for giving us the chance to know You by washing away our sin.

2027-01-22.title: Be The One
2027-01-22.verse: And a son was also born to Seth, whom he named Enosh. At that time people began to worship the Lord.
2027-01-22.observation: It appears as though humanity started going down a bad path. People began to grow more distant from God. There is a great conversation to be had about why and how important it is for us to teach the next generation to follow the Lord. However, at some point, someone has to be the one to start moving in the right direction. This does not mean you have to be a “world changer,” a “trendsetter,” or a “once-in-a-generation” type person. That’s a lot of pressure. All you need to do is decide that you want to follow the Lord. It does not matter what others are doing. It doesn’t matter if you are the only one. Someone has to be the first in your family or friend group to follow the Lord. Seth decided to change things. He had a son named Enosh, and they began to worship the Lord by name. Will you be the one, too?
2027-01-22.application: Don’t be ashamed to follow the Lord today. Someone has to be the first.
2027-01-22.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for giving us the opportunity to follow You.

2027-01-23.title: The Goal of Closeness
2027-01-23.verse: The entire lifetime of Enoch was 365 years. Enoch walked with God, and then he disappeared because God took him away.
2027-01-23.observation: I heard someone once say, “You don’t want to be so Heavenly minded that you are no Earthly good.” This is probably true, but I have rarely ever been around anyone like this. I have been around people who are very focused on Heaven, but not to the point they were not of any good on Earth. Actually, I think that the more you have an accurate view of Heaven, the more you will be doing good on Earth. One of the reasons why is because you realize how good God is and you live with the joy of His fellowship. Another reason is that you realize something good is coming and you work in preparation. Finally, one more reason is an accurate view of Heaven steals the fear of what happens after death. Therefore, you no longer live as though you only have this life to find joy. When we get an accurate view of Heaven and make it our goal to walk closely with God, great things happen.
2027-01-23.application: Think about Heaven and walking closely with Him today. What do you love about having God in your life?
2027-01-23.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for the opportunity to spend eternity with You.

2027-01-24.title: Our Job is Obedience
2027-01-24.verse: And Noah did all that God commanded him—he did indeed.
2027-01-24.observation: I cannot imagine how difficult it would be to even begin to understand the task given to Noah. He is supposed to build a massive boat that will basically be a life raft to save humanity and the animals God created. How do you even begin to start attacking this job? Noah realized the only thing to do was to do what God said. He did not decide to figure it out on his own. He did everything the Lord said. In our lives, we will come across issues that are bigger than us and seem impossible. Our job is not to try and outthink God or figure it out by ourselves. Our job is to figure out what would be most honoring to the Lord and then do that. God will take our best effort and do something amazing.
2027-01-24.application: What is the most God-honoring way you can fulfill your commitments and live your life today? Do that.
2027-01-24.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for helping us take every single step.

2027-01-26.title: The Lord Shows Mercy
2027-01-26.verse: And the Lord smelled the soothing aroma and said to himself, “I will never again curse the ground because of humankind, even though the inclination of their minds is evil from childhood on. I will never again destroy everything that lives, as I have just done.
2027-01-26.observation: When Noah worshiped the Lord for bringing him through the storm, God shows mercy and says He will never allow another devastating flood like that to destroy the world. Since that time, there have been many localized floods, but none have ever been that devastating again. Many times, it’s not just that we make it through a storm, it is also how we make it through the storm that makes the difference. Noah was not bitter. Noah worshiped the Lord for bringing him through the storm. When we realize God’s mercy despite the difficulties of life, God’s blessing is on us.
2027-01-26.application: No matter what difficulty you face today, take a moment and be thankful. Watch what it does for your soul.
2027-01-26.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for all You are constantly doing in our lives.

2027-01-27.title: Seasons Change Over Time
2027-01-27.verse: The entire lifetime of Noah was 950 years, and then he died.
2027-01-27.observation: Only a couple of chapters ago, the world looked very different from how it does now. In this chapter, God opens up a whole new aspect of life. They are now able to eat meat, but they have to do so in a humane way. Then, even mighty men fall. At last, we realize that even mighty men die. All things change, except for God. It would be hard to believe that someone like Noah was human when you realize what God used him to do. However, all men are mortal and die. Only the Lord is truly righteous and holy. This is important because we have to be careful never to place our heroes on unfair pedestals. Allow them to be human. We still hold them accountable, but we never place our ultimate hope in them. Our ultimate hope is in God.  So, let the seasons change. The Lord stands unmoved.
2027-01-27.application: Are you grieving the loss of a sweet time in your life or are you wishing the current season would change? Don’t worry. All seasons change. What good thing can you be thankful for about today?
2027-01-27.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for Your faithfulness in all seasons.

2027-01-28.title: Our Family Tree
2027-01-28.verse: This is the account of Noah’s sons: Shem, Ham, and Japheth. Sons were born to them after the flood.
2027-01-28.observation: When we read through chapters that are full of names we do not recognize, we can be tempted to skip over all the people who have gone before us. This is common and it is like hearing the stories from someone else’s family. However, that is the very reason we should read these chapters. This is not another person’s family. This is ours. All people came from the family of Noah. Therefore, these people are part of your story. Also, reading these names places our story firmly within history. These people lived. They navigated many of the issues we face today. They had to deal with pain, suffering, joy, fear, and gladness. Not only that, but they had to trust in the Lord and do the best they could. Each generation built on the legacy of trusting in the Lord. Now, it is our turn.
2027-01-28.application: What legacy are you building into the chain of our family tree?
2027-01-28.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for being with each generation that lives on Your Earth.

2027-01-29.title: We Must Follow God’s Directions
2027-01-29.verse: Then they said, “Come, let’s build ourselves a city and a tower with its top in the heavens so that we may make a name for ourselves. Otherwise we will be scattered across the face of the entire earth.
2027-01-29.observation: After the flood, the people began to do the same thing again. They wanted to reach God, but do it in their own way and by their own designs. God sees this and has to frustrate their plans. This is because it does not work. We do not get to God by our own effort. We get to God by trusting in Him and through relationship. The idea of getting to God through works and finding our own way is still a problem today. People claim to be “spiritual” instead of Christian because they want to make a religion that fits their own image of what should be done. God will frustrate these plans, as well. There is only one way to God.
2027-01-29.application: Take a moment and think about how you relate to God. Is it born out of trust and relationship or out of making God into your own image?
2027-01-29.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for walking with us every day as we slowly figure out how to follow You.

2027-01-31.title: A Brave Adventure
2027-01-31.verse: Now the Lord said to Abram, “Go out from your country, your relatives, and your father’s household to the land that I will show you. Then I will make you into a great nation, and I will bless you, and I will make your name great, so that you will exemplify divine blessing. I will bless those who bless you, but the one who treats you lightly I must curse, so that all the families of the earth may receive blessing through you.
2027-01-31.observation: It is hard to imagine the amount of bravery it took for Abraham to leave everything and follow God. Not only was he leaving everything behind and journeying to an unknown destination, but he was also leaving the so-called protection of the local gods. During the time, many people thought that “gods” were local. He would have not only left his country, but also left the protection of his local deity. Abraham trusted God. At some point in our lives, God will ask us to trust Him. The greatest trust will be when we have to choose to trust Him with our salvation. However, it is not a journey into the unknown. It is an adventure with God. He is always with us and walks with us just as He did with Abraham.
2027-01-31.application: Think of your life as an adventure with the Lord. This means there will be monsters, hardships, and valleys. There will also be mountain tops, victories, and great moments of triumph. God is with us through it all.
2027-01-31.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for walking with us in all things.
